answer_1.quote: ...we evaluate the model on the task of creative image captioning... We develop a machine-in-the-loop system called Creative Rewriting Assistant (CRA) which either rewrites a span of text or infills between two pieces of text when requested...
answer_1.outputs: creative image captions and rewritten or infilled text spans

answer_2.quote: ...we calculate the fraction of model suggestions accepted by the users... we calculated the Rouge-L recall score of accepted suggestions against the final caption submitted by the user... we measure the count of unique trigrams in the generated captions... we calculate the perplexity of the final captions using a pre-trained GPT2 model...

answer_4.quote: Once users submit the final caption, they are asked to complete a survey to rate the helpfulness and grammaticality of the assistant as well as their satisfaction with the final caption... We ask a 'third-party' human annotator (who did not participate in the writing task) to compare the captions pairwise for each image and pick the more creative caption...
answer_4.guideline: Participants answered Likert-scale questions about helpfulness, grammaticality, and satisfaction; third-party annotators were instructed to choose the more creative caption for each image.
